topic: keep a car battery from dying while the car sits unused for weeks
core_question: How do I stop my car's battery from going dead while the car isn't being driven? (secondary: How do you restore a couch's sagging cushions so they look and feel full again?)
answer_summary: Hook up a trickle charger or automatic battery maintainer to the battery terminals to keep it topped off during extended periods of disuse.; after the topic shift: Open the cushion covers and add a new high-density foam insert (or extra fiberfill/batting wrap) to restore loft and firmness.
